title: Shelving Filter
text: Second-order IIR shelving filter, 4 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough; {Specify gain from input port} uses additional input port to specify gain, {Gain (dB)} sets the peak gain, {Specify slope from input port} uses additional input port to specify slope, {Slope} sets the filter slope, {Specify cutoff frequency from input port} uses additional input port to specify cutoff, {Cutoff frequency (Hz)} sets the filter cutoff frequency, {Type}, {Inherit sample rate from input} sets the source of input sample rate, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input, {Visualize filter response} sets the open plot to visualize filter response, {Variable name}, {Overwrite variable if it already exists}, {Export filter to workspace} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.values: Use additional input port to specify gain off (default) | on
